detail: Full summary: Verified the read-only guarantee empirically rather than asserting it: mtime+size hash of every file under .twining/ is byte-identical before and after a probe run. Probe also degrades correctly — empty store yields all LOW N rather than false REFUTES, missing .twining/ exits 2.
